about.title: Zila Panchayat Initiative
about.para1: The Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) is a key initiative of the Government of India aimed at promoting cleanliness, environmental protection, and scientific waste management in rural areas. In line with this, the District Panchayat Almora has set up a comprehensive solid and plastic waste management system across various rural, tourist, and religious places in the district.
about.para2: To properly dispose of the plastic and solid waste generated daily in Almora's rural markets and semi-urban areas, several measures are in place:
about.point1Text: Appointed for regular waste collection and management.
about.point3Text: Set up to sort and process recyclable materials.
about.point4Text: Operated to compress and recycle plastic waste.
about.goal: The primary goal of this initiative is to turn cleanliness into a people's movement while ensuring environmental conservation and sustainable development.
